Duncan Engineering Ltd suffers from a catastrophic disconnect between its equity base and shareholder returns, evidenced by a dismal return on equity of -48.22% against a sector benchmark of 11.88% [E8]. This stagnation has caught up to profitability, as evidenced by a 50% collapse in compounded profit growth over the trailing twelve months [E16]. Meanwhile, market expectations remain dangerously detached from operational reality as price growth has outpaced profit growth by 26% [E49], driving recent momentum firmly into negative territory with a 24% share price decline over the past year [E20] and a 9% drop over 3 years [E19].
